goal: The terminal tab is a real terminal on macOS and Windows: a pty behind xterm.js, so interactive programs, prompts, colours and resizing work as they do in PowerShell or Ghostty, with the ownership contract (one shell per tab, a journal, a verified stop) unchanged.
scope: A. node-pty inside the owned worker: a login shell on macOS, PowerShell 7 (or Windows PowerShell) through ConPTY on Windows; the service gains raw write and resize and keeps line input for the ownership contract
B. xterm.js in the tab: keystrokes to the pty, bytes to the emulator, fit on resize, the app's theme, ⌘F find, copy on select, links, the assistant's command mirror, Clear and Restart
C. Ghostty as a second engine: tried 3–4 October, removed by the owner's decision (D-one-terminal-engine)
D. Windows: the ownership tour and the interactive tour in the real app on a hosted Windows runner (.github/workflows/terminal-windows.yml, on demand)
acceptance: Interactive programs run in the tab on macOS: a prompt that reads input, less on the alternate screen, colours, a resize the shell sees; the login shell with TERM=xterm-256color (tour)
On Windows PowerShell runs through ConPTY inside the owned Job with the same ownership journal and verified stop (hosted Windows runner)
The assistant's commands still mirror into the tab; ownership refusals and the unverified-shutdown path are unchanged (unit tests)
One emulator: the Ghostty engine, its setting, dependency and security-policy exception are removed (owner decision 2026-10-04)
nextAction: C090 is delivered in v0.6.0-nightly.20261004.2 with xterm.js as the only emulator. Next: run the Windows terminal job on pull requests that touch the terminal; then C089's owner items (a working day in the browser; the two desktop bench columns).
truthReview: 2026-10-04: the terminal tab is a pty (node-pty 1.1.0 in the owned worker: login shell on macOS, PowerShell 7 or Windows PowerShell through ConPTY on Windows) behind xterm.js 6, with ghostty-web 0.4.0 as a chosen engine. Proven on this Mac (four tours: two engines, two themes, eleven checks each; ownership unit tests 10/10; ownership tour; journey 76/76; the packaged app in the earlier nightly) and on a hosted Windows runner at 2c541667 (https://github.com/FRIKKern/barkdown/actions/runs/37165383336): node-pty spawns PowerShell through ConPTY under Electron's node, unit tests 10/10, the ownership tour in the real app (commands, profile switch, killed app, explicit start, quit, legacy launch; five owned workers verified stopped) and the interactive tour with thirteen checks (Read-Host answered live, a one-key read, colours, resize, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, the alternate screen, find, the mirror strip, themes, restart). Found and fixed on the way: white text in the light theme (a light-dark() colour xterm.js cannot parse); the assistant's mirrored lines overwritten by ConPTY, now a strip of their own under the terminal on both platforms; the text read breaking at soft wraps; Playwright's page never answering on a Windows runner when video recording is on (tests only). Corrections to earlier statements: hosted Windows runners were available (the Actions budget block was September's; the zero-job failures were visual.yml's duplicate key, now removed). Limits: a Ghostty tab keeps its open-time theme and has no Find; the Windows proof is a hosted runner from source, not the packaged app and not the owner's machine; no Windows nightly exists. Delivered for macOS in v0.6.0-nightly.20261003.3 (chain receipt on b684800f). Polish after that nightly: a faint scrollback slider; ghostty-web's in-canvas scrollbar strip no longer blanks the last columns; a plain click under Ghostty no longer replaces the clipboard (that, not ConPTY, was why its Ctrl+V pasted one letter on Windows — both engines paste there now). Delivered with the polish in v0.6.0-nightly.20261004.1 (chain receipt on db4f012c). 2026-10-04, owner decision: the Ghostty engine is removed (code, setting, dependency, the wasm-unsafe-eval exception; the bundle went from 3.3 MB to 2.7 MB). xterm.js is the only emulator; the tour is eleven checks in each theme. The removal is delivered in v0.6.0-nightly.20261004.2 (chain receipt on 0a3346be); the Windows job is green on 3e0e2db2 (run 37191999825) and the ownership tour passes against the packaged Barkdown.app from that nightly.
